name: Sharp lag — slow markets against Pinnacle's de-vigged fair
sport: NFL, NCAAF, NBA, NHL, MLB, MMA
hypothesis: When a slow market (a Kalshi game-winner YES price, a DraftKings line) sits at least 2.5 percentage points below Pinnacle's Shin de-vigged fair for the same outcome, after the slow market's own fees, the slow market is lagging the sharp reference, and the gap is realised as positive closing-line value against Pinnacle's close.
objective: Measure, in the open and from the first flag, whether such gaps carry positive CLV against Pinnacle's close; report hit rate, average CLV and lag to converge by sport, market and trigger. Research only: no flag is a recommendation.
primary_metric: Mean CLV in percentage points over graded flags, CLV = Pinnacle's closing Shin fair for the flag's side and point minus the flag's all-in cost (DraftKings: 1 / decimal price; Kalshi: YES ask + taker fee), with its game-clustered 95% bootstrap interval.
unit: One flag: one target venue, one side at one point, one episode (a new flag on the same event, venue and side waits until the last one's gap has converged under 1.0 pp). Clusters: the game (event_id).
baseline: No lag: a target that does not lag Pinnacle closes, on average, where it was priced at the flag, so mean CLV is at most 0.
training_window: None. Nothing is fitted: every number is fixed in advance (spec below).
validation_window: None. There is no tuning step to validate.
holdout_window: Every flag written from the first one onward (Pinnacle observations resume with the provider's cycle on 2026-11-01). Evaluated when 200 graded flags exist, and at every further 100 graded flags; each look is reported, and the repeated looks are disclosed here because they raise the chance of a false pass.

machine.window_note: [from, to): open-ended; the flag table is append-only

minimum_sample.note: Below 200 graded flags the record is descriptive and the model cannot be eligible. Every flag counts, losses included.

promotion_criteria.decision_rule: eligible = true only if BOTH criteria hold on the graded flags at the time of evaluation. A criterion that cannot be evaluated is not met. Eligibility does not promote the model: a person promotes it to VALIDATED through a validation report. Software tests passing is never evidence for any criterion.

criteria.rule: At least 200 graded flags (close_status = 'graded'). Flags with no usable close are counted and reported (the no-close count and rate), never graded and never counted toward the 200.

The lower end of the two-sided 95% percentile interval of the mean CLV (pp, flag-weighted) is above zero. The interval is a cluster bootstrap that resamples whole GAMES (event_id) with replacement: 2,000 resamples, mulberry32 seeded 20261026 (lib/edgedesk_sharp_lag.js clusterBootstrap), because flags in one game share its news and its close and are not independent.

promotion_criteria.family_correction: Both are required (an intersection test); neither is reported as a pass on its own.

candidates_tried.kalshi_fee_until_verified: highest plausible (0.07, one contract, rounded up)

alternatives_considered_not_tried: multiplicative or power de-vig (capture's devig() offers both; Shin is its default and the board's sharp_fair)
the Kalshi mid instead of the ask (the ask is what a contract costs)
a consensus of books instead of Pinnacle as the reference
comparing spreads and totals across different points
forking_paths.choice_and_reason: One candidate, written before any flag: 2.5 pp (the owner's threshold), Shin (one fair across the stack), the ask plus the highest plausible fee until a schedule is verified (a conservative cost), same point only (no point conversion model), and the existing 90-minute past-price rule.
forking_paths.data_already_seen: None: no Pinnacle observation exists after 2026-10-10 13:55Z (the provider quota was spent) and Kalshi snapshots begin 2026-10-21, so no gap has been computed and no flag has been written or graded.
forking_paths.stopping_rule: No stopping: the record runs on. Eligibility is evaluated at 200 graded flags and every 100 after.

spec.reference: Pinnacle, from odds_gateway snapshots (featured / close boards and the capped sharp_check category), de-vigged with Shin (capture's devig(); an underround pair normalised proportionally and labelled)

targets.draftkings: the same snapshots' DraftKings price, cost = 1 / decimal (vig included)
targets.kalshi: linked game-winner markets (kalshi_game_links, NFL and CFB), cost = YES ask + taker fee; fee = round_up_to_cent(c x contracts x p x (1 - p)); until verified c = 0.07 on one contract and the flag is fee_unverified

triggers.nba_injury: a starter (top 5 of the reference rotation by minutes) changes status between consecutive reports
triggers.nhl_goalie: a club's consensus starter changes goalie or status
triggers.kalshi_move: a linked YES mid moves 3c+ between consecutive snapshots <= 10 minutes apart

grade.close: the last Pinnacle observation of the side and point at or before the start, at most 90 minutes before it; otherwise no close (counted, reason kept, excluded from CLV)
grade.lag: first target observation after the flag within 1.0 pp of the then-current fair, censored at the start; reported with the flag's snapshot resolution

spec.code: lib/edgedesk_sharp_lag.js (inlined in supabase/functions/sharp_lag and sharp_check); supabase/sharp_lag.sql
known_limitations: lag is measured only to the snapshot cadence (hourly boards; 5-minute Kalshi)
Kalshi's fee schedule is unverified until an operator records it
spreads and totals are compared only at the same point
a triggered check lands up to an hour after its trigger (the gateway's hourly rule)
NBA and NHL are covered only once their gateway rows are enabled
